scope: Human skin palette review for plans that explicitly bind this amendment.
precedence: For bound plans, this decision supersedes older numeric red-minus-blue ceilings for human skin in shared character contracts or scene prompts. Preserve all non-skin rules and checks.

human_skin_tolerance.appearance: Human skin should read as warm brown.
human_skin_tolerance.acceptance_condition: Values up to about 140 are acceptable when the skin still reads as warm brown.
human_skin_tolerance.above_threshold: Anything above about 140 needs a redraw.
